name: JB gateway burns pair JB after every sell
summary: The unverified JB gateway's sell function (0x53a9fcbc) swaps the caller's JB for USDT through the JB/USDT pair and then has the JB token (0xb1faeac6, callable by the gateway) burn about 80% of the sold amount from the pair's balance and sync it, so each sell pushes the JB price back up. The attacker bought 120M JB with 70M Venus-borrowed USDT and sold it back in 16 cycles, taking the pair's 50,000 USDT.
notes: Gateway and token are unverified; the mechanism is read from the trace. Resets: the gateway's slot 4 set to its price contract 0x06f6935d (updatePrice() is called on every cycle) and the token's slot 6 set to the gateway (its burn-from-pair caller), both by the deployer within a minute of deployment.
The PoC makes its contract the referral helper's owner only as a harness shortcut; the real attack contract bound itself to the root referrer with an ordinary bindReferrer call (0x998449ca).
JB is unpriced and crashed; it is valued at the USDT realised (rule 12). The copycat 0xfb86175c one block later took the remaining 41.9 USDT.
